responsibility: This file implements fragment-based output assembly for the mc front end. It creates temporary fragment files keyed by numeric IDs, records them in an index and a cleanup list, lets clients designate a final destination file, then reopens each fragment in order and copies its bytes into the destination before deleting temporary files, making it the subsystem for building one output file from separately emitted pieces.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file implements fragment streaming mechanics: it creates temporary /tmp fragment files, tracks them in indexes and lists, copies fragment contents into the destination file, and unlinks the temporaries. The same-stem header only publishes the fragment-stream API.
